product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform that helps legal teams create, review, negotiate, approve, sign, and manage contracts in one system.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes flexible, contract-volume-based pricing.

employee_band.notes: Company-size range listed on its LinkedIn profile.

hq_location.notes: SpotDraft’s own funding announcement identifies Bengaluru as headquarters and New York as an office; its LinkedIn profile instead lists New York.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover SpotDraft’s Angular architecture and its Bazel-based ML build and deployment workflow.

public_docs.notes: Its public knowledge base contains multiple product and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An open Product Manager - AI posting has an application link.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4, hosted on Microsoft Azure Enterprise
model_provider.notes: The VerifAI FAQ identifies GPT-4 as its primary model; the subprocessor list also names OpenAI.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly listed compliance frameworks; ISO 27001 is identified as v2022.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 27, 2026: an $8 million strategic Series B extension from Qualcomm Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 27, 2026, $8 million financing falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board lists LegalTech - Sales Development Representative and additional SDR openings.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 29, 2026, SpotDraft announced its Claude connector, enabling customers to query their contracts through Claude.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On December 3, 2025, SpotDraft announced Alon Waks as CMO and Amit Sharma as CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are documented product-integration signals, not confirmation of SpotDraft’s internal CRM stack.
